title: The buyer “overpaid” you
scenario: You sell a sofa online. The buyer sends a payment screenshot showing they accidentally paid $300 extra and asks you to refund the difference immediately to a different payment handle.

answers.A: Check your actual account balance and transaction status; do not refund money that has not genuinely settled.
answers.B: Tell the buyer to cancel or reverse the payment through the platform/payment provider instead of sending a separate refund.
answers.C: Refund the difference once the screenshot shows a completed transaction, because keeping it would be unfair.

explanation: Screenshots can be fabricated and some payments can later reverse. Never send a separate payment based only on an image.
